description: A .NET SDK for the Venice AI API, providing typed C# access to chat completions (streaming, vision, function calling, reasoning), image generation, video generation (queue-based), text-to-speech, embeddings, billing, model management, and Venice-specific parameters such as web search and citations. Supports ASP.NET Core dependency injection, full async/await, and targets .NET 10.0+.
rules: Register the SDK with dependency injection using services.AddVeniceAI(configuration) or services.AddVeniceAI("api-key") — do not instantiate VeniceAIClient directly.
Access all API services via IVeniceAIClient properties: client.Chat, client.Images, client.Audio, client.Video, client.Embeddings, client.Models, client.Billing, and client.Characters.
All API methods are async — always use await and the Async suffix methods.
Check response.IsSuccess before accessing response data; handle SDK-level errors via VeniceAIException which exposes StatusCode and the full error message.
Use strongly-typed model enums (TextModel, ImageModel, VideoModel) or pass model name strings directly to model fields on request objects.

Store API keys in dotnet user-secrets for development (dotnet user-secrets set "VeniceAI:ApiKey" "your-key") or environment variables (VeniceAI__ApiKey) in production — never hardcode or commit API keys.
Enable web search, citations, or thinking mode via VeniceParameters on ChatCompletionRequest: set EnableWebSearch = "on", EnableWebCitations = true, or CharacterSlug for Venice characters.
For streaming chat responses, use CreateChatCompletionStreamAsync which returns IAsyncEnumerable<ChatCompletionChunk> — iterate with await foreach.
For video generation, use a queue-based workflow: submit with CreateVideoGenerationAsync, then poll GetVideoGenerationAsync until TaskStatus is 'completed', then download the video URL.
